subject: [PATCH 0/6] memcg: group struct fields by access pattern

reviews.author: Andrew Morton
reviews.summary: Identified significant repair work needed for struct mem_cgroup_per_node and struct mem_cgroup alterations due to pending changes. Requested the author to check the modifications.

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memcg performance by introducing a contract that ensures struct fields are sorted into named cache line groups based on access patterns, preventing false sharing and reducing the likelihood of performance regressions.
